notes: Circuit: D9 -> red wire -> R1 (220 ohm) -> LED anode; LED cathode -> black wire -> GND. This matches the schematic.

The breadboard in the image is rotated, so each 5-hole strip runs horizontally. The strip columns used (1t, 4t, 5t) are chosen to match the picture's relative layout. Strip 1t holds the red wire and R1 leg 1. Strip 4t holds the LED cathode and the black wire. Strip 5t holds R1 leg 2 and the LED anode. R1 passes over strip 4t without being inserted in it.
The LED's bent leg (anode) is in the same strip as R1's lower end. The straight leg (cathode) shares a strip with the black GND wire.
The Yún's GND header pin is the one the black wire goes to, in the lower power header.
